scan_basis: scans the first 200 .py files under swarm_v2/core (sorted); each curated antibody's line_pattern is reduced to a literal substring (regex metacharacters, shorthand classes and (?...) groups removed, escaped literals unescaped) and matched against every source line; findings are real substring occurrences counted per severity and error_type, persisted to swarm_v2_artifacts/security_scan_report.json. Substring matching is broader than the Python regex (word boundaries and inline (?i) are not enforced) and multi-branch (a|b|c) patterns reduce to a concatenation that does not match — both are properties of the no-regex port, not defects.
